policies.text: Ground transit capability standards are satisfied either by arranging at least 10 luxury coach transfers or by operating a fleet of no fewer than 10 active executive shuttles.
Express rail freight clearance is granted to any rail operator achieving a safety rating of at least 95 percent.
Eco-friendly fleet designation is awarded to commercial bus lines recording average carbon emissions below 120 grams per kilometer.
Provider preference designation is assigned to any operator that satisfies ground transit capability standards.
Managing leadership conference transport is recommended for entities holding VIP travel service accreditation.
VIP travel service accreditation requires an operator with provider preference designation along with a record of at least 40 completed corporate trips.
An airline fulfills operational flight thresholds when registering a minimum of 300 flight hours.
Maritime service activity criteria are met by completing at least 100 port visits.
Quality assurance validation is granted to any aviation service holding ISO 9001 certification.
